title: Control plane shadow-upgrades + traffic shadowing framework (Terraform modules & health validations)
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Problem: Upgrading control plane components in customer VPCs is high-risk. Existing approaches rely on incremental canary traffic routing or phased rollouts that still touch live traffic. We need a reproducible, infrastructure-first mechanism that lets us validate a new control plane version under realistic load patterns without affecting primary control plane behavior.
goal: Provide a Terraform-native pattern and orchestration primitives to perform shadow (traffic-mirroring) upgrades of the control plane and to automatically validate version health via synthetic and mirrored traffic before any live-traffic promotion or customer-facing switch.
non_goals: Full blue/green swap automation (out of scope for this ticket)
Replacement of existing canary code paths; this augments them
acceptance_criteria: Terraform modules deploy a 'shadow' control plane variant in a customer VPC without changing the primary control plane endpoint
Traffic shadowing component mirrors ~1-5% of request volume (configurable) to the shadow instance while returning responses from the primary instance to customers
Automated preflight jobs run schema and operator compatibility checks against the shadow instance and fail fast on migration incompatibilities
Health/quality gates (latency P95, error rate, model output divergence heuristics) are configurable and evaluated automatically; roll-forward is blocked on regressions
Rollback plan can be executed by operator with a single CLI/console action and completes within SLO windows
Documentation + runbook published and linked from Console upgrade workflow
rollout_plan: 1) terraform apply modules: create shadow-controlplane-{version} ASG/pool and traffic-mirroring proxy in private subnets
2) start shadow control plane with identical config except version tag and telemetry sidecar in trace-only mode
3) enable traffic-mirroring proxy to copy 1-5% of live requests to shadow, with buffering and rate-limits
4) run preflight validation jobs (schema check, operator API smoke tests, KV cache warm-up) on mirrored traffic
5) collect metrics for 6 hours (configurable) and evaluate against thresholds via automated gate (latency/error/divergence), failing early on regressions
6) if gates pass, escalate to manual promotion step (operator review) which can either: A) promote traffic gradually, or B) schedule blue/green swap (separate change)
7) if gates fail, trigger automated teardown of shadow nodes and capture full diagnostics bundle for triage
terraform_changes: New module: private/controlplane/shadow - manages lifecycle of shadow control plane pool, IAM roles, and DNS entries (shadow-only)
New module: private/traffic/mirroring-proxy - deploys a highly-available mirroring proxy (Envoy-based) with config for sampling rate and backpressure handling
New resources: S3 diagnostics bucket with restricted KMS key, SQS dead-letter queue for mirrored request capture, CloudWatch/Datadog dashboards for shadow metrics
Module tests: terratest suite and a lightweight acceptance step that can be run in CI against a test VPC
health_checks: Liveness and readiness probes for control plane APIs with extended timeout during migration windows
Synthetic API flows executed against shadow instance (create->read->update->delete) to validate end-to-end correctness
Model-output divergence metric: sample hashed outputs from primary and shadow for non-sensitive prompts and compute semantic similarity distribution
KV cache warm-up success metric and hit-rate target after mirrored traffic run-in
Resource saturation alarms (CPU/GPU/IO) and queue length thresholds tie into gating logic
rollback_strategy: Automated: if preflight gates breach thresholds, terraform destroy shadow-controlplane and mirror-proxy, and publish diagnostics to S3
Manual operator rollback: one-click 'disable mirroring' from Console plus 'destroy shadow' CLI command to tear down resources
Post-mortem artifacts: retained snapshot of diagnostic traces, duplicated requests, and a 'repro bundle' with exact terraform plan + variables
Safety nets: provisioned throttle on mirror proxy to avoid overloading shadow; circuit-breaker to stop mirroring on backend errors
metrics: P95 latency comparison (shadow vs primary) over sampling window
Semantic divergence percentiles for sampled responses
testing: Unit: terratest for Terraform modules to validate resource creation and outputs
Integration: deploy to an internal test VPC, enable full mirroring at low qps, run preflight smoke suite
Staging: run 24h shadow run against real traffic samples in staging with telemetry export to Datadog
Chaos: simulate node failures and network partitions to validate mirror proxy backpressure and DLQ behavior
Security: run KMS/access audit and penetration checklist on shadow resources
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Mirrored traffic contains sensitive PII -> Mitigation: sampling filter and obfuscation pipeline before storing any mirrored payloads
Risk: Shadow instance consumes excessive resources -> Mitigation: strict autoscaling caps and mirrored QPS throttle
Risk: Divergence false positives from non-deterministic model outputs -> Mitigation: use semantic similarity and statistical thresholds rather than strict equality
Risk: Terraform drift between primary and shadow -> Mitigation: canonicalized module inputs and CI checks to enforce parity
